⚠️TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Whitbourne RCMP urges motorists to use extreme caution while travelling in the area. Police are receiving reports from motorists experiencing very poor visibility due to whiteout conditions. Many drivers are finding themselves stuck in the snow – particularly on the on and off-ramps from the Trans-Canada Highway, which are snow-covered and slippery.

Please delay any non-essential travel until road and weather conditions improve. If you must travel, slow down and use extreme caution. Avoid sudden braking and ensure your lights are on so others can see you. 

#nltraffic

data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY (Fort Sanders) - KUB crews have implemented the following road closures for water system repairs:

- 12th Street between Forest Avenue and Highland Avenue
- Highland Avenue between 11th Street and 13th Street

Crews have valved off the damaged water main, which will allow surface water migrating towards World's Fair Park Drive to recede. Repairs are expected to continue through Tuesday, February 3, in this area. Flaggers and other traffic control measures are in place to assist with traffic flow in the area. Updates will be posted as conditions warrant.
